change.description: Add separately reported live wait states, persisted task identity colors, and durable execution and task-deferral timelines.
change.release_unit_description: Task operations API, maintenance-store timeline migration, and responsive task workspace.

planned.reasoning: The runtime fields and timeline endpoint are additive, while stable colors and durable observation add a forward-compatible maintenance-store migration. Legacy request-time and duration meanings remain unchanged.

scope_drift.description: The implementation matches the accepted durable-timeline scope and adds only forward-compatible maintenance-store schema and response fields.

current.reasoning: A migration persists task colors, actual execution boundaries, deferral intervals, coverage sessions, and timeline revisions. Existing control columns and legacy history semantics are preserved.

verified.reasoning: The maintenance-store schema change is additive and idempotent; public response changes remain additive and legacy task-control semantics are preserved.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing clients may continue reading legacy task fields and sending enabled-only PATCH requests; task colors, queue/admission availability, and the timeline endpoint are additive.

persistent_state.state_description: Existing maintenance controls and task-run history plus stable colors, actual execution boundaries, task-deferral intervals, observation sessions, and coverage revisions.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Existing same-major releases with the maintenance task tables; direct major skips remain unsupported.
